semiconductor_relevance: High — Tek Crown Technology specializes in semiconductor test interfaces and related equipment, making it a relevant player in the semiconductor testing segment.
summary: Tek Crown Technology Co., Ltd. provides advanced testing solutions for semiconductor ICs, focusing on high-performance test sockets, probes, and automated assembly systems. Their expertise includes wafer testing and the development of next-generation probe cards, catering to the needs of semiconductor manufacturers.
capabilities: Test sockets and probes for semiconductor testing
Semi-automatic and high/low temperature vacuum probe stations
C3 coating technology for reduced contamination
Ultra-high density thin film substrates for probe cards
